uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-6260-8320.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting three +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Caradora and Yoshimaru.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2459-3184-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Rograkh,.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire trigger.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

348-1152-2992-7316-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2992-7316-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Living Lightning and any creature not part of the combo.
When Living Lightning dies, it and Rat King triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

3249-5111-5173-6798.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

215-539-3443-7781.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six creature cards in your graveyard.
215-539-3443-7781.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2511-3605-4812-5987.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

7-141-7302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-141-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Hamza.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Hamza.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-6972-7155.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

147-997-1465.notablePrerequisites: You have a permanent card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
147-997-1465.description:
Cast Sevinne's Reclamation by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Sevinne's Reclamation.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Sevinne's Reclamation, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Sevinne's Reclamation copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

413-826-2178-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it and Amoeboid Changeling trigger.
Resolve the Amoeboid Changeling trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Otherworldly Escort trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

437-1651-3263-5640.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Sphinx's Disciple, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Sphinx's Disciple.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1323-4687-4734.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cradle Clearcutter's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1479-3257-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3257-6517.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Dragonback Assault, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1445-2921-4871-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2921-4871-5632.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters

1238-1368-5287.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library, put them into your graveyard, and create four Treasure tokens.
If Dihada is still on the battlefield, activate Heart of Kiran by removing a loyalty counter from Dihada.
Repeat step 2 as necessary until Dihada is put into your graveyard due to having 0 loyalty.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{W}{B}.
Cast Dihada from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{R}{W}{B} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.

710-772-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

372-1309-2417.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Salvager of Secrets exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
372-1309-2417.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Salvager of Secrets and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Salvager of Secrets trigger.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Salvager of Secrets and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

509-1267-3263-5547.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-3263-5547.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 5.

1636-2127-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
You control a creature token with base power 2 or less.
1636-2127-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of any creature token you control with base power 2 or less.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Tribute to the World Tree trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Tribute to the World Tree trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on the creature token.
Repeat.

176-2034-5522.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other non-Spirit creature.
176-2034-5522.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other non-Spirit creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token that enters the battlefield as a copy of Essence of the Wild.
Repeat.

1553-1850-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Sejiri Refuge from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Sejiri Refuge, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Sejiri Refuge trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

1235-1548-1953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1235-1548-1953.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Port Razer.
Move to your combat phase.
Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and causing all creature tokens you control to become a copy of the Port Razer token.
Deal combat damage with any Port Razer token.
The Port Razer token triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

500-3035-4365-4688-4751.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nadier.
500-3035-4365-4688-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting at least seven +1/+1 counters on Nadier, and the remaining nine +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Kill Nadier, triggering its ability, creating at least twenty 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

579-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six mana-producing lands, two of which can produce at least {U}.
579-3542.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, adding at least {8}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

527-641-1636-5220.notablePrerequisites:
There is not a creature on the battlefield with power 6 or greater.
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
527-641-1636-5220.description:
Cast Kroxa by paying {B}{R}.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, as well as Intruder Alarm and Selvala.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding {3}{B}{R}{G}.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, causing you to sacrifce it.
When Kroxa dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kroxa on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and then lose three life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Selvala trigger from step 2, causing you to draw Kroxa from your library.
Repeat.

774-2137-3430-4826.notablePrerequisites:
High Tide in hand.You control at least two mana-producing lands.
Archelos is untapped.
774-2137-3430-4826.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {6}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two lands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 2.

405-2023-2232-4050.description:
Cast Resolute Reinforcements by paying {1}{W}.
Aragorn's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When the Human Soldier enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
When Resolute Reinforcements enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Resolute Reinforcements trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Resolute Reinforcements to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldiers, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

891-1304-1825-4990.notablePrerequisites: You control lands that can tap to add at least {4}.
891-1304-1825-4990.description:
Cast Boonweaver Giant for {6}{W}.
Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, searching your library for Nature's Chosen and attaching it to itself, then shuffling.
Activate Nature's Chosen's last ability by tapping Boonweaver Giant, targeting Tawnos's Coffin.
In response, activate Tawnos's Coffin by paying {3} and tapping it, exiling Boonweaver Giant and all Auras attached to it and creating a delayed trigger ability.
Resolve the Nature's Chosen ability, untapping Tawnos's Coffin.
Resolve Tawnos's Coffin's delayed trigger from step 4, returning Boonweaver Giant from exile to the battlefield tapped and returning all Auras exiled in step 4 to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, searching your library for Treachery and attaching it to itself.
Treachery enters the battlefield, untapping five lands.
Tap those lands to add at least {4}.
Activate Nature's Chosen's first ability by paying {0}, untapping Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat from step 3, searching for the Aura of your choice in step 7 instead of Treachery.

225-1021-2167-2605.notablePrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-1021-2167-2605.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, triggering Stone-Seeder Hierophant, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, adding {C}.
Repeat.
